column5: Bash programmable completion exposes COMPREPLY but no public per-candidate description channel
Only Zsh exposes native completion groups through the supported provider path
Every line editor can apply an item produced by its own native provider
Bash has no public arbitrary-line equivalent of Zsh _main_complete or Fish complete -C
Current Fish and Bash line-editor APIs do not support the same faithful display and partial-accept contract
Native directory completion commonly classifies a symlink to a directory as a directory; Shell Sense retains its lexical resource without inventing a symlink kind
Bash cannot safely execute the mailbox decoder from a signal trap while Readline owns the stack; documentation is consumed by the next Shell Sense action
Native completion functions execute synchronously in the owning shell; superseded results are rejected, but arbitrary shell completion code cannot be safely interrupted mid-call
